study_identification_part.si_4_title: Rightward brain structural asymmetry in young children with autism

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized the Shanghai Autism Early Developmental (SAED) Cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Participants were recruited from a neurodevelopmental project - Shanghai Autism Early Development Cohort [40].

answer.SAED: normative training/testing (cross-validation) and extraction of individual deviations for clinical research

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Typically developing (TD) children from the SAED cohort were used to train and validate the normative models. Patient groups (ASD with/without DD/ID and DD/ID only) from the same cohort were used for clinical evaluation of atypical deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: GPR models of GMV asymmetry for each ROI were trained based on 247 TDs... Fivefold cross-validation was conducted... Then, we put the individual GMV asymmetry metric and covariate variables (age and sex) of children in the ASD with DD/ID, ASD without DD/ID and DD/ID only groups into the generated models and obtained the individual Z scores
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: METHODS / Statistical and normative modelling analysis

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A total of 219 TD children were included in the study. Although the Methods section (L139) mentions 247 TDs for model training, the Participants section (L105) and Table S2 explicitly state 219 TDs. The total study N of 1030 (563 + 212 + 36 + 219) confirms 219 is the final sample size. The training was conducted using cross-validation and finally on the total TD sample to extract patient deviations.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: ...and 219 age-matched TD children (4.42 ± 1.62 years, range from 1.17 to 7 years, 107 males). ... Individual regional GMV deviations in 3 diagnosis groups were then extracted from normative models trained by total TD children and each fold.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Geng2025.pdf.md: METHODS / Participants; RESULTS / Atypical GMV asymmetry deviation patterns

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics for the healthy control (TD) group are reported as a mean of 4.42 years and SD of 1.62 years, with a range from 1.17 to 7 years. These values apply to both overall and training phases as the full healthy sample was used for final model development.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: 219 age-matched TD children (4.42 ± 1.62 years, range from 1.17 to 7 years, 107 males).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The TD group of 219 children consisted of 107 males (48.9%). The number of females (112, 51.1%) was derived by subtracting the number of males from the total N (219 - 107 = 112).
